package.name: big_bertha_bringup
package.description: Hardware bringup for the physical Big Bertha quadruped (Arduino UNO Q, MG995 servos, YDLidar X2, MPU6050). Contains the TCP bridge ROS 2 node (hardware_bridge_node) and the UNO Q firmware app (sketch + Python relay) that drives the PCA9685 servo controller and reads the MPU6050 IMU. The autonomy stack (state_estimation, mapping, localization, planning) is hardware-agnostic and reused with use_sim_time:=false; only the sensor drivers and the servo bridge replace the simulation layer.
